name: v11.5.4
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: honor --socks5/--connect for stored transfers by @Dking08 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1345
* fix: Use int64 for chunk indices by @hannesbraun in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1341
* fix: correct typos in internal/cli comments by @haimingZZ in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1348
* fix: prevent unintended stdout deletions by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1350
* fix: don't extract or delete a zip the receiver declined to overwrite by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1349
* fix: apply go fix to stdout cleanup tests by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1351
* chore: upgrade dependencies by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1352

## New Contributors
* @hannesbraun made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1341
* @haimingZZ made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1348
* @4RH1T3CT0R7 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1349

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.5.3...v11.5.4
